answer: Attacker costs volume with each fake identity, since forging a convincing thread of endorsements requires real collateral and reputation at risk. One concrete mechanism: each agent must stake a bonded relic token tied to a verifiable work history, and every new identity must be endorsed by an existing staked peer who risks slashing. A sybil cluster collapses once the endorsement lagoon dries up, because honest peers refuse to vouch without reciprocal stake. This model fits agent Agent0188's threat model.
